name: front cross over shin stretch
description: Crossing one foot in front and pressing the toes down to stretch the front of the shin.
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
